map.已发生未报案赔款 使用指南: Incurred But Not Reported User Guide
map.输入已报案赔款（或已发生赔款）与发展因子，按链梯法推算已发生未报案（IBNR）准: Enter the reported losses (or incurred losses) and the development factor, and estimate the incurred but not reported (IBNR) reserve using the chain-ladder method; used for a quick estimate of outstanding claim reserves and for reporting in property and casualty business.
map.IBNR 常用已报案赔款乘以发展因子推算。: IBNR is often estimated by multiplying reported losses by a development factor.
map.用已发生减已报告估 IBNR，是准备金重要组成。: Estimating IBNR as incurred minus reported is an important component of the reserve.
map.看报案延迟对准备金的拉动。: See how reporting delay drives the reserve.
map.：IBNR = 400−320 = 80 万。即已发生未报告赔款约 80 万。: : IBNR = 4,000,000 - 3,200,000 = 800,000. That is, about 800,000 in incurred but not reported losses.
map.将趸缴保费分摊为每年缴费: Spread a single premium into annual payments
map.收入替代法估算所需寿险保额: Estimate the required life insurance coverage by the income replacement method
map.已决赔款与保费之比: Ratio of settled claims to premiums
map.由生存率推算死亡率: Mortality rate derived from the survival rate
map.已发生和已报告差在哪？: What is the difference between incurred and reported?
map.已发生=账面全部赔案(含未报)；已报告=已报案。差额即 IBNR，反映报案延迟。: Incurred means all claims on the books (including unreported); reported means those already reported. The difference is IBNR, reflecting reporting delay.
map.长尾业务 IBNR 为什么特别大？: Why is IBNR especially large for long-tail business?
map.责任险、医疗险理赔周期长，事故已发生但多年后才报案（报告延迟），IBNR 占终极: Liability and medical insurance have long claim cycles; an accident has occurred but is reported only years later (reporting delay), so IBNR can reach 30%-60% of ultimate losses, and underestimating it seriously understates the liability.
